description:
Morning Bliss Music | Sitar Instrumental | 1.5 Hours to Rise and Shine

Some mornings just need a little light let in. If you want to start the day feeling open, clear and quietly glad to be up, press play before anything else.

This bright Indian sitar music is designed to lift your morning gently: a warm, unhurried melody that wakes you up without rushing you.

Enjoy 1.5 hours of sitar with soft tabla, slow and glowing, with no vocals.

▶ Keep the morning bright — the full Morning Energy playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID&list=PLeZN0byo199l9NGQ0ig-jCkqp0iwI3c7m
(paste this video's own id in place of VIDEO_ID before publishing — it opens the playlist at this video so the next one plays automatically)

Perfect for waking up, a slow breakfast, tea or coffee on the balcony, morning stretches, yoga, journaling, getting ready, a calm commute, tidying the house, or easing into work in a good mood.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Sitar with soft tabla
Raga: Alhaiya Bilawal (a bright, open morning raga)
Style: Indian classical instrumental
Mood: Light, warm, quietly joyful
Atmosphere: First sun through an open door, a warm cup, a fresh day
Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes

🎧 HOW TO USE
Play it as you get out of bed and keep it in the background through your first hour. Open a window, take a few slow breaths and let the long sitar notes set an easy pace. Speakers fill a room nicely; headphones bring out the detail of the strings.

⏱ CHAPTERS
0:00 First light
9:00 Opening the window
18:00 A slow warm stretch
27:00 Morning bliss
36:00 Light on the floor
45:00 Clear and easy
54:00 A quiet smile
1:03:00 Rise and shine
1:12:00 Bright and steady
1:21:00 Ready for the day

⏱ BEST FOR
• Waking up gently
• A positive start to the day
• Breakfast and morning tea
• Yoga and stretching
• Journaling and gratitude
• Getting ready
• A calm commute
• Light housework
• Easing into work
• Bright background music for the home

If this music helped you start the day brighter, subscribe to Raga Focus for more uninterrupted Indian instrumental music.
